interface.longDescription:
Tako brings premium live data from authoritative providers into ChatGPT, together with web search, in one call. Its licensed sources include S&P Global, Fiscal.ai, Visible Alpha, and Xignite. Its official statistics come from FRED, BLS, OECD, BIS, IMF, World Bank, and Census. Its prediction-market odds come from Polymarket. Tako returns current figures as citation-backed, interactive charts, shown inline in a carousel, alongside web results.

Use it for company financials and analyst estimates, stock prices and valuation, economic indicators such as inflation, unemployment, GDP, and interest rates, website traffic, prediction-market odds, sports statistics, demographics, energy, and real estate.

Tako also fetches the full text of a web result or the data rows behind a chart, lists the data it holds on a company, country, or metric, and turns data you provide into a shareable chart.

For research rather than a lookup, ask for Tako's agents. They plan and run several searches across Tako's data and the web, and return a cited answer with the charts and lists they built, shown inline. The Tako agent ranks and screens by financial and economic metrics, and aggregates across many companies or countries. The company agent screens companies by registry facts such as status, incorporation date, location, and industry, and finds the officers, directors, and controllers recorded in public company registries.

Tako is for analysts, researchers, writers, and anyone who needs a sourced number. Sign in with a Tako account to use it. Charts you create from your own data are public: anyone with the link can open them. Coverage varies by metric and region.

publication.release_notes: Tako now ships two skills: tako-search for lookups, and tako-agent for research you ask Tako's agents to run. They replace the three topic skills. Search shows every card in a carousel, and the agents' charts and lists render inline. The listing leads with Tako's premium data, adds screenshots, and its review cases cover both agents.
